package.name: amr_sensor_bsp
package.description: Board Support Package validation layer. Sensors publish to *_raw topics; this package republishes validated copies on the plain topic names, and nothing in the navigation stack subscribes to a raw topic. Includes the per-model IMU angular-velocity plausibility check, camera content validation, and IMU-informed ground-return rejection that keeps a 2D LiDAR usable on the warehouse ramps.
